subject: Unable to connect to yahoo finance using  package tseries get.hist.quote() function

messages.author: 594a05774774ad3d
messages.subject: Unable to connect to yahoo finance using  package tseries get.hist.quote() function
parts:
Hi,

I am unable to download stock price data when I deploy my app on shinyapps.io. It works perfectly on local machine and plots a graph. Any advise would be highly appreciated.

The link to the app can be found here: https://prorithm.shinyapps.io/prorithm_shiny_beta/

I am using tseries package get.hist.quote() function. tseries vignette

A snippet of logs is as below:

messages.subject: Re: Unable to connect to yahoo finance using package tseries get.hist.quote() function
parts:
IIRC, there was a similar problem recently with "quantmod":

https://github.com/joshuaulrich/quantmod/issues/149

It evidently has to do with Yahoo requiring an https connection. I
don't know how to fix your problem, except maybe contact the package
maintainer(s). The problem with quantmod got fixed pretty rapidly.
